manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball moves up and down beside a fixed height scale with a launch guide. The blue v arrow shortens, disappears at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed a arrow stays the same and points down.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const ta=u/g;const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const H=u*u/(2*g);const top=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const base=360,sc=240/1.3;const y=base-h*sc;const x=300;const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({id:'lane.toss',x:20,y:40,w:600,h:370,title:'Tossed ball',state:st}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',120,base,520,base,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',130,base+18,'Launch height 0 m',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.axis('ax',{x:90,y:base,length:260,orientation:'y',min:0,max:1.3,ticks:[0,0.5,1],label:'Height',unit:'m'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',x,y-15,30,{role:'output'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:x+40,y:y-15},{value:top?0:v,direction:'up'},{scale:30,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:x+90,y:y-15},{value:-g,direction:'up'},{scale:6,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(430,150,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:H,velocity:v,height:h}};}
